description: Per airline, from ANAC's latest monthly VRA file: scheduled flights, cancellations and departures more than 15 minutes late, with rates. Use for 'which Brazilian airline cancels or delays most'. Needs the aviation sector licensed. Deterministic: computed from official datasets, no model in the loop.

entity.description: Optional. One airline by name, e.g. 'Azul', 'LATAM'.

name: airline_punctuality
title: Airline cancellations and delays (ANAC VRA)
